brief:
Moshe Feiglin, leader of the Zehut party and former Likud member of Knesset, is campaigning on a platform calling for ethnic cleansing of Gaza and Israeli settlements there, Middle East Eye reported. Feiglin defended the slogan "Occupation. Expulsion. Settlement" as part of his political messaging.

The campaign represents an explicit call for the displacement of Gaza's Palestinian population and colonization of the territory by Israeli settlers, framing such moves as central to his political program.

title: Israeli politician campaigns on ethnic cleansing platform for Gaza
